propositions: rebar link caused_by accepts any target without verifying the target has a referencing commit, allowing misattributions and unvalidated causation edges
the referencing-commit scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits as private code, conflating unreadable git history with absence of commits

the refusal rule must check the resolved target itself (not descendants) for >=1 referencing commit, since caused_by names the specific introducing change and hierarchy promotion would recreate the misattribution
caused_by links are refused identically across library, CLI, and MCP interfaces, with a --force escape hatch allowing bypass when justified
the reconciler applies inbound peer-authored caused_by edges with force="inbound reconcile: peer-authored edge" to preserve sync, while commit-less code repos allow the link unverifiable
the close command's --caused-by flag writes via transition_close._apply_caused_by and is not gated by this rule, with documentation clarifying the scope distinction
